item.title: WFW advises CMC on landmark LNG carrier joint ventures
item.description: Watson Farley & Williams has advised China Merchants Capital Management Co. and China Great Bay Area Fund Management Co. Ltd on a series of joint ventures with a global financial institution.

item.title: Naftogaz receives first US LNG delivery to Ukraine
item.description: Naftogaz, in partnership with Poland’s ORLEN, has secured delivery of the first batch of American LNG to Ukraine in 2026.

item.title: RWE signs MoU with ADNOC
item.description: RWE has signed an agreement with ADNOC to enhance energy security in Germany and Europe.

item.title: Port of Rotterdam increases bio-LNG bunkering
item.description: In 2025, maritime shipping bunkered six times more bio-LNG in the Port of Rotterdam compared to 2024.

item.title: Eni celebrates Congo LNG Phase 2 first cargo
item.description: Phase 2 of the Congo LNG project has now entered commercial production, following the first cargo of LNG from the Nguya FLNG floating facility.

item.title: New Zealand moving closer to LNG import terminal
item.description: New Zealand’s Energy Minister, Simon Watts, has said the government will contract to build an LNG import facility to strengthen New Zealand’s energy security and support economic growth.

item.title: EXMAR awarded FLNG contract for Cedar LNG
item.description: EXMAR has been selected by Cedar LNG Partners LP to provide its marine and operational expertise for the floating LNG unit, megúgu.

item.title: JERA signs LNG supply agreement with QatarEnergy
item.description: JERA Co., Inc. has announced the signing of a long-term LNG sale and purchase agreement with QatarEnergy to secure the supply of 3 million tpy for 27 years.

item.title: Centrica Energy and Seneca Resources Company sign long-term MiQ methane emissions certificates agreement
item.description: Centrica Energy and Seneca Resources Company have announced an agreement to support independently verified methane emissions from an MiQ-certified US natural gas producer.

item.title: Mugardos Energy Terminal ready to supply bio-LNG
item.description: The Mugardos Energy Terminal, owned by the Reganosa Group, now offers a new bio-LNG supply service for ships and tankers.
